objective: Implement closed EnvironmentPreparation profile, inventory, remediation, effect, verification, readiness, and traceability artifacts with strict validators.
included: Canonical schemas and validators for all seven EP interface intents.
Exact baseline, profile, fingerprint, grant, receipt, outcome, checkpoint, and evidence semantics.
Malformed, stale, substituted, additional-property, secret, and drift fixtures.
deliverables: EP-001 schemas, validators, exports, and conformance fixtures.
verificationMethod: Validate positive artifacts and exhaustive malformed, stale, substituted, additional-property, secret-value, and digest-mismatch fixtures.
successCriteria: Every EP artifact validates only under its exact closed contract and no adapter can assert readiness or graph authority.

objective: Implement two-layer environment profiles, deterministic routing, and native Windows host inventory with exact redacted evidence.
included: DevRelay host plus named project profile resolution.
Required and optional checks for OS, architecture, shells, runtimes, package managers, SDKs, tools, services, environment variables, paths, and attestations.
Offline read-only Windows inventory with ignore, privacy, freshness, and support-claim controls.
excluded: Automatic remediation, machine-global mutation, or unproven project-technology support claims.
deliverables: Environment profile engine, operation router, native Windows inventory, fingerprints, and raw observation receipts.

dependencyHints.rationale: Profiles and observations must emit the finalized EP contracts.

verificationMethod: Run deterministic Windows inventory, profile selection, required/optional, redaction, attestation-expiry, unsupported-target, and zero-call replay matrices.
successCriteria: The exact host and project requirements resolve deterministically and inventory produces complete redacted evidence without overstating support.

objective: Implement consolidated remediation planning and safe, project-local, reversible, checkpointed preparation effects.
included: One ordered remediation wave for all required gaps.
Exact effects, grants, impact, rollback, idempotency, before/after fingerprints, and evidence obligations.
Crash-safe checkpoints and zero-effect replay.
excluded: Silent retries, implicit network access, unapproved machine-global changes, or work execution.
deliverables: Remediation planner, effect coordinator, rollback controller, checkpoint recovery, and mutation receipts.

dependencyHints.rationale: Remediation must be derived from exact observed profile gaps.

verificationMethod: Exercise approve, reject, partial grant, network-denied, global-mutation, rollback, crash, retry, stale fingerprint, secret, and idempotent replay cases.
successCriteria: Only approved reversible effects execute, every transition is receipted, recovery is deterministic, and replay performs zero effects.

objective: Implement capability-oriented optional inventory, acquisition, configuration, service-check, and target-probe adapter bindings with honest maturity.
included: Provider-neutral manifests and capability negotiation.
Exact version, configuration, grant, execution, evidence, failure, and substitution receipts.
Fixture, unavailable, malformed, and at least one live Windows conformance path where release claims require it.
excluded: Tool-specific Core routing or support claims without live evidence.
deliverables: Environment adapter SDK, manifests, bounded host executors, conformance suite, and maturity records.

dependencyHints.rationale: Adapters are bounded by the canonical EP request and receipt contracts.
Effect adapters require finalized grant, checkpoint, and rollback semantics.

verificationMethod: Run live and fixture conformance, unavailable, malformed output, provider substitution, undeclared effect, grant escalation, secret, network, and fallback matrices.
successCriteria: Adapters remain swappable and untrusted, and maturity claims exactly match archived provider evidence.

objective: Implement the Core-owned EnvironmentVerificationGate and single-attempt readiness binding before every WorkExecution frontier.
included: Required/optional policy truth table and closed Gate outcomes.
Repository, baseline, profile, adapter, tool, host, target, frontier, work-item, assignment, and attempt binding.
Immediate fingerprint revalidation, drift handling, single-use receipts, and baseline establishment.
excluded: Changing the dependency DAG, assignment, schedule, or product work.
deliverables: EnvironmentVerificationGate, readiness binder, policy engine, baseline store, and drift/remediation routing.

dependencyHints.rationale: The Gate requires exact current profile facts and fingerprints.
Readiness evaluates the finalized preparation evidence and checkpoints.

verificationMethod: Test every Gate outcome, policy truth table, failed/unknown required checks, warning-only optional checks, drift, expiry, substitution, receipt reuse, frontier mismatch, and replay.
successCriteria: WorkExecution cannot start without one exact current Gate-owned receipt and any material change invalidates that authorization.

objective: Implement trusted forward traceability from profiles and readiness to work items, execution attempts, evidence, and graph checkpoints.
included: Trusted contributor vocabulary and deterministic graph updates.
Adapter isolation, endpoint validation, atomic merge, replay, merge proof, and orphan diagnostics.
Queryable provenance for why an environment check or preparation effect exists.
excluded: Adapter-authored graph operations, arbitrary relationships, or stored inverse edges.
deliverables: Environment traceability contributor, queries, updates, merge proofs, and diagnostics.

dependencyHints.rationale: The contributor requires finalized readiness and trace contracts.
Only Gate-approved readiness facts can enter the graph.

verificationMethod: Validate forward vocabulary, source closure, adapter isolation, unknown endpoints, atomic merge, replay, orphan detection, and provenance queries.
successCriteria: Every approved readiness decision is reconstructable through the lifecycle while untrusted adapters have no graph authority.

objective: Integrate environment profiles, remediation review, readiness status, and evidence into the supported ChatGPT/Codex Desktop Windows library and guidance.
included: Human-readable pre-effect display of mutations, grants, impact, rollback, checks, warnings, and evidence.
Module/plugin catalogs, package exports, examples, reports, ProjectOverview, operator documentation, and support claims.
Clear separation from deployment, staging success, ReleasePreparation, and public npm publication.
excluded: A one-click Desktop plug-in, hosted service, or unsupported host claim.
deliverables: Desktop-facing APIs, commands, catalogs, examples, reports, and operator documentation.

dependencyHints.rationale: Desktop behavior must match final Gate and readiness semantics.
Catalog and maturity guidance must reflect verified adapter behavior.

verificationMethod: Run package export, installed-package import, catalog, example, report parity, documentation link, support-claim, and Desktop interaction fixtures.
successCriteria: A Windows Desktop user can understand, approve, remediate, verify, and audit the environment without hidden effects or stale claims.

objective: Add exhaustive environment determinism, security, mutation, recovery, drift, concurrency, telemetry, and transition-safe regression coverage.
included: Property, mutation, negative, permission, secret, network, path, rollback, crash, replay, graph, and installed-package matrices.
Bounded parallel read-check and serialized-effect tests.
Per-check duration, retries, cache hits, changed facts, command fingerprints, and bottleneck receipts without asserting a universal wall-clock SLA.
excluded: Weakening fail-closed behavior or rewriting historical evidence.
deliverables: EP-001 complete regression, security, recovery, concurrency, mutation, and telemetry suites.

dependencyHints.rationale: The complete matrix verifies the integrated runtime, adapters, package, reports, and Desktop surface.
The regression gate must include approved graph contribution and replay.

verificationMethod: Run focused, mutation, permission, security, crash, drift, concurrency, repeatability, telemetry, canonical verify, catalog, and installed-package suites.
successCriteria: All EP failure modes and authority boundaries are covered, deterministic repeats match, telemetry is complete, and every prior release gate remains green.

objective: Prove EnvironmentPreparation and EnvironmentVerification end to end in a clean ChatGPT/Codex Desktop Windows run using the packed DevRelay library.
included: Establish exact host and project profiles, inventory current facts, expose a controlled gap, review and apply reversible remediation, and pass the Gate.
Begin one bound WorkExecution attempt, introduce drift, block reuse, remediate, reverify, and resume.
Archive raw commands, versions, grants, fingerprints, effects, rollback, readiness, graph, replay, and installed-package evidence.
excluded: Public npm publication, deployment, staging success, hosted backend, or unsupported target technology claims.
deliverables: Clean Windows Desktop environment-preparation dogfood, evidence, lifecycle report, milestone, and acceptance package.

dependencyHints.rationale: The release-defining Desktop run requires the complete green regression and security gate.

verificationMethod: Run the installed package through clean inventory, controlled remediation, readiness, execution binding, drift, blocked reuse, re-preparation, re-verification, recovery, and zero-effect replay.
successCriteria: A Windows Desktop user can safely prepare and prove the exact environment before execution, detect drift, recover deterministically, and trace every decision and effect.
